self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Verdant Wind: Normal/Charged Attack hits have a 50% chance to generate a Cyclone that deals 80% ATK DMG per tick (every 0.5s for 4s) to drawn-in opponents; can only occur once every 10s. Modeled as a supplementary hit per tick — its own rotation target (weapon/extraHit), weight = how many ticks the rotation catches; physical, scales with ATK and CRIT only, no DMG% bonuses.

en.flavor: A pure green hunting bow. This once belonged to a certain hunter whose home was the forest.

refinements.1: Upon hit, Normal and Charged Attacks have a 50% chance to generate a Cyclone, which will continuously attract surrounding opponents, dealing <r>40%</r> of ATK as DMG to these opponents every 0.5s for 4s. This effect can only occur once every <r>14</r>s.
refinements.2: Upon hit, Normal and Charged Attacks have a 50% chance to generate a Cyclone, which will continuously attract surrounding opponents, dealing <r>50%</r> of ATK as DMG to these opponents every 0.5s for 4s. This effect can only occur once every <r>13</r>s.
refinements.3: Upon hit, Normal and Charged Attacks have a 50% chance to generate a Cyclone, which will continuously attract surrounding opponents, dealing <r>60%</r> of ATK as DMG to these opponents every 0.5s for 4s. This effect can only occur once every <r>12</r>s.
refinements.4: Upon hit, Normal and Charged Attacks have a 50% chance to generate a Cyclone, which will continuously attract surrounding opponents, dealing <r>70%</r> of ATK as DMG to these opponents every 0.5s for 4s. This effect can only occur once every <r>11</r>s.
refinements.5: Upon hit, Normal and Charged Attacks have a 50% chance to generate a Cyclone, which will continuously attract surrounding opponents, dealing <r>80%</r> of ATK as DMG to these opponents every 0.5s for 4s. This effect can only occur once every <r>10</r>s.
